summary: Iteration 7 tested the real Razorpay integration architecture (SDK wired, HMAC helpers, entitlements gating, verify + webhook idempotency) against an intentionally unconfigured environment. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_payments.py with 17 pytest cases — all PASS. Backend regression suite (/app/backend/tests/test_astroai_api.py) — 13/13 PASS. Playwright verified frontend states: Checkout shows 'Payment gateway not yet configured', pay button disabled with 'Payments not configured' label, LockedCta[data-testid=locked-cta-kundli] renders on locked payload with '₹99' unlock button that routes to Checkout, Dashboard entitlements chip flips from 'Free preview' to 'Kundli unlocked' (data-testid=ent-chip-kundli) after a paid order is inserted into MongoDB, and the full interpretation (16,679 chars) renders unlocked while LockedCta is removed.
critical_code_review_comments: PaymentService reads env at __init__ once at import time (server.py: `payments = PaymentService()`). If RAZORPAY_* creds are added to .env later, the process must be restarted (or PaymentService instantiated per-request) — this is fine given the deployment model but worth noting in an operations runbook.

verify_webhook_signature returns False for empty body — Razorpay never sends an empty body so this is correct, but if a legitimate zero-length payload is ever expected, the check should be split into 'has secret' + 'has signature' rather than 'has raw_body'.

In server.py the /api/payments/verify endpoint raises 400 on signature failure — good. Consider logging a WARNING with order_id + user_id server-side for security auditing (currently silent update to signature_failed).

Webhook endpoint returns 503 when secret is unconfigured — Razorpay expects a 2xx quickly; while unconfigured this is fine (no webhooks will be dispatched anyway), but after configuration make sure the raw-body path never touches request.json() (it doesn't currently — correct).

PACKAGES const in App.js is defined AFTER App() function that references it via closure. Works due to var/const hoisting semantics only because Checkout is a function-declaration and PACKAGES is captured at call time; still brittle — recommend hoisting to top of file.

App.js remains a single ~78-line file with very dense one-liners; module-level split (Auth, Home, Checkout, KundliForm, PalmFlow, Dashboard, LockedCta) is overdue for maintainability but does not affect correctness.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified end-to-end contracts: (1) GET /api/payments/config returns {configured:false, key_id:'', test_mode:true, prices:{palm:9900,kundli:9900,bundle:15900}, currency:'INR'}. (2) POST /api/payments/order → 401 unauth, 503 with exact message 'Razorpay is not configured on the server. Ask the administrator to set RAZORPAY_KEY_ID, RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET, and RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET.' when authed. (3) PaymentService.verify_checkout_signature is HMAC-SHA256(order_id|payment_id, KEY_SECRET) using hmac.compare_digest — true for good signature, false for tampered/missing. (4) verify_webhook_signature is HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, WEBHOOK_SECRET) — false when secret empty or body empty. (5) create_order (with mocked razorpay.Client.order.create) enforces PRICES_PAISE server-side: palm=9900, kundli=9900, bundle=15900 — Pydantic OrderInput has NO amount field so client tampering is a no-op. (6) /api/entitlements reads from db.orders where payment_status='paid': fresh user → all false; kundli order → {kundli:true, palm:false, products:['kundli']}; bundle order → {palm:true, kundli:true, products:['bundle']}. (7) /api/kundli/latest gates interpretation to <=620+1 chars with locked:true/preview:true/unlock_product:'kundli'/unlock_price_paise:9900 when unpaid; full length (16k+ chars) with locked:false when paid. Same for /api/palm/latest (test skips if no palm reading exists to avoid slow AI call). (8) /api/payments/verify with bad signature returns 400 AND updates the order to payment_status='signature_failed' with entitlements still all-false; second call on an already-paid order returns {status:'paid', already:true, entitlements:{...}} — idempotent. (9) /api/payments/webhook returns 503 (Webhook secret not configured) in the current env — full HMAC + idempotency path is exercised in unit tests via monkeypatch. (10) Frontend: Checkout renders 'Payment gateway not yet configured' with disabled button labelled 'Payments not configured', free preview button routes to Palm/Kundli. LockedCta renders on data.locked with 'Unlock full report · ₹99' which routes to Checkout. Dashboard chip 'Free preview' flips to 'Kundli unlocked' (data-testid=ent-chip-kundli) after a direct DB paid-order insert + navigating back to Dashboard. Full 16,679-char interpretation renders after unlock.
